description: Source code for nested tensor utilities in PyTorch, including functions for getting nested tensor sizes, strides, offsets, and splitting nested tensors.

classes.name: NestedTensorImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for nested tensors in PyTorch.

methods.name: _nested_tensor_size
methods.description: Returns the size tensor of a nested tensor.

methods.name: _nested_tensor_strides
methods.description: Returns the strides of a nested tensor.

methods.name: _nested_tensor_storage_offsets
methods.description: Returns the storage offsets of a nested tensor.

methods.name: NestedTensor_get_max_size_from_size_tensor
methods.description: Computes maximum size across nested tensor sizes.

methods.name: NestedTensor_get_max_size
methods.description: Gets maximum size from a NestedTensorImpl object.

methods.name: get_consistent_last_dim_of_nested_tensor
methods.description: Checks and returns the last dimension size if consistent across nested tensor.

methods.name: chunk_nested_tensor
methods.description: Splits a nested tensor into chunks along the last dimension.

methods.name: split_with_sizes_nested
methods.description: Splits a nested tensor into parts with specified sizes along the last dimension.

methods.name: value_selecting_reduction_backward_nested_symint
methods.description: Placeholder for backward reduction in nested tensors, not implemented in C++.
